work.summary: Add explicit active-visit state and compact 100m nearby candidates without treating GPS proximity as visit identity.
implemented: Nearby candidates are distance-sorted and never auto-selected.
Exactly one explicit active machine persists in localStorage across reopen.
Visit completion clears matching active machine.
Active machine is pinned after report capture and suppressed from duplicate Today list.
OCR result text is compared with active machine name/management code and match/mismatch UI is exposed.
No DB/schema migration and no Analytics RAW mutation.

openItems: Production deployment and iPhone interaction verification
nextAction: Deploy OPS10C, then request only the finite iPhone interaction checks required to close the phase.
